verdict.rationale: Vercel's docs directly state that teams and invited collaborators can comment on preview and production environments through an in-browser toolbar. Marketplace integrations that turn comments into GitHub, Jira, or Linear issues and send Slack notifications for comments show the feature is real and integrated, though all evidence is short first-party summaries. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of commenting workflows and permissions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can let teammates and collaborators comment directly on preview and production environments
